item.title: New nickel mine proposed for central B.C.
item.description: The proposed project is expected to boost Canada’s annual nickel output by 40 per cent

item.title: Average asking rents in Canada fall for 16th straight month: report
item.description: Asking rents in Canada fell two per cent year-over-year in January to an average of $2,057, marking the 16th consecutive month of annual rent decreases. A report from Rentals.

item.title: New Flair Airlines CEO to be based in Toronto, not Vancouver
item.description: Len Corrado had retired from Sunwing Airlines last year after a seven-year stint that included almost three years as president

item.title: US stocks drift higher as gold, silver and bitcoin stabilize
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. stocks drifted slightly higher in mixed trading, a comedown following bursts higher for stocks in Asia earlier in the day and Wall Street’s own rally to close last week. The S&P 500 rose 0.5% Monday.

item.title: Tech stocks push Canada, U.S. markets higher as precious metals also rise
item.description: TORONTO — Markets in the U.S. and Canada rose on Monday, helped by gains in technology stocks.

item.title: Why many B.C. seniors struggle with poverty and homelessness
item.description: Half of B.C. seniors live on an after-tax income of less than $35K per year

item.title: 'Strategic choice': B.C. backs bid to host new defence bank in Vancouver
item.description: VICTORIA — British Columbia's government is supporting a private bid to host a new international bank to finance military projects by democratic nations, with Premier David Eby calling Vancouver the "strategic choice" to host it.

item.title: BC Greens won't renew accord with NDP, citing 'undelivered or stalled' commitments
item.description: VICTORIA — The BC Green Party announced Monday that it will not renew an accord with the Premier David Eby's NDP when the deal expires next month, potentially undermining the stability of the provincial government with its one-seat majority.

item.title: Is 24 bedrooms of social housing at $8.5M good bang for City of Vancouver’s buck?
item.description: City uses design catalogue from CMHC for the first time on a project at 3122 Southeast Marine Dr.

item.title: Eddie Bauer looks to sell Canadian stores amid financial struggles
item.description: TORONTO — The future of Eddie Bauer’s Canadian stores is hinging on whether the company can find a buyer.
